mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memberStatus(num, member_id, status_code, memo, register_id, reg_date) VALUES (memberStatus_seq.NEXTVAL, #{member_id}, #{status_code}, #{memo}, #{register_id}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE members SET last_login = SYSDATE, fail_cnt = 0 WHERE member_id = #{member_id}
UPDATE members SET last_login = SYSDATE, fail_cnt = 0 WHERE login_id = #{login_id}
mapper.select: SELECT m1.member_id, m1.login_id, password, sns_provider, sns_id, email, enabled, created_at, update_at, last_login, name, TO_CHAR(birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') birth, email, tel, profile_photo, zip, addr1, addr2, receive_email, authority FROM members m1 LEFT OUTER JOIN member_details m2 ON m1.member_id = m2.member_id LEFT OUTER JOIN security m3 ON m1.login_id = m3.login_id WHERE m1.member_id = #{member_id}

SELECT m.member_id, m.login_id, m.password, m.status, m.fail_cnt, m.blocked_until, m.last_login, d.name, d.email, d.birth, d.phone, s.role, ( SELECT MAX(wm.role) FROM workspace_members wm WHERE wm.member_id = m.member_id AND wm.status = 0 ) AS workspaceRole FROM members m LEFT OUTER JOIN member_details d ON m.member_id = d.member_id LEFT OUTER JOIN security s ON m.member_id = s.member_id WHERE m.login_id = #{login_id}
mapper.update: UPDATE members SET fail_cnt = 0 WHERE login_id = #{login_id}
UPDATE members SET fail_cnt = fail_cnt + 1 WHERE login_id = #{login_id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members WHERE UPPER(login_id) = UPPER(#{login_id})
SELECT m.login_id FROM members m JOIN member_details d ON m.member_id = d.member_id WHERE d.name = #{name} AND LOWER(d.email) = LOWER(#{email})
SELECT m.member_id, d.name, m.login_id FROM members m JOIN member_details d ON m.member_id = d.member_id WHERE m.login_id = #{login_id} AND d.name = #{name} AND LOWER(d.email) = LOWER(#{email})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO password_reset_tokens (token_hash, member_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{token_hash}, #{member_id}, SYSTIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '10' MINUTE)
mapper.select: SELECT member_id FROM password_reset_tokens WHERE token_hash = #{token_hash} AND expires_at > SYSTIMESTAMP AND used_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE password_reset_tokens SET used_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE token_hash = #{token_hash} AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at > SYSTIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id, m.login_id, m.password, m.status, m.fail_cnt, m.blocked_until, s.role FROM social_accounts a JOIN members m ON a.member_id = m.member_id JOIN security s ON s.member_id = m.member_id WHERE a.provider = #{provider} AND a.provider_user_id = #{provider_user_id}
